ruleset.name: CosmicCache
ruleset.description: Hygiene gate: the plugin follows WordPress-style formatting (spaced function calls, Allman braces, trailing commas), which deliberately diverges from PSR-12. This ruleset therefore checks only mechanical hygiene every file must satisfy: Tabs for indentation, no trailing whitespace, final newline, no BOM, lowercase keywords/constants, no stray spaces in control structures.
